evidence: NHDPlus v2 labels the Rio Pueblo de Taos below its confluence with the Rio Fernando de Taos (drainage over 300 km2) as 'Rio Fernando de Taos'. USGS names every gauge on that stretch Rio Pueblo de Taos (08275300 near Ranchito, 08276000 at Los Cordovas, 08276300 below Los Cordovas), and the Rio Fernando's own gauge (08275000) drains 159 km2. Checked 2026-09-29.

NHDPlus v2 leaves Ute Creek unnamed below Holkeo Creek (191 km, 482 to 4,730 km2) down to the Canadian River, so USGS 07226500 Ute Creek near Logan (daily flow from 1941) was assigned to the Canadian. Same level path as the gauge. No GNIS id in NHDPlus; the id is ours. Checked 2026-09-29.

NHDPlus v2 leaves the Rio Ojo Caliente unnamed below the Rio Tusas (13 km, 1,014 to 1,174 km2), so USGS 08289000 Rio Ojo Caliente at La Madera (daily flow from 1932) was assigned to Arroyo el Rito by the downstream walk. Same level path as the gauge. No GNIS id in NHDPlus; the id is ours. Checked 2026-09-29.

NHDPlus v2 leaves the Rio Mora (Pecos River tributary) unnamed (29 km, 16 to 139 km2), so USGS 08377900 Rio Mora near Terrero (daily flow from 1963) was assigned to the Pecos River. Same level path as the gauge. No GNIS id in NHDPlus; the id is ours. Checked 2026-09-29.
